messages: So I heard you told people I didn't pull my weight on the presentation.
That's not a small thing. You went behind my back and said it to the whole department.
I don't care what you meant. The effect is what matters and you embarrassed me.
You always do this — you say something damaging and then act like I'm the one overreacting.
I worked on that project for three weeks straight. THREE WEEKS.
You know what your problem is? You take all the credit and spread the blame.
Don't walk away from me mid-conversation, that's incredibly disrespectful.
I'm shaking right now I'm so angry.
This is not over. I want a real conversation when you're ready to be honest.
Until then I have nothing to say to you.
